calls.title: GrowthBook and Life360
calls.summary: In this sales call, Daniel Wathne (GrowthBook sales lead) and Logan Bates (solutions engineer) discussed with Russ Painter (Life360 DTC/web optimization) Life360's need for a cheaper, server-side experimentation tool that integrates with Contentful CMS and exports data to Databricks, replacing the expensive StatSig. Pain points included StatSig's high cost, limited data passing, and poor hybrid front-end/back-end testing. Next steps: GrowthBook will send documentation and a use case, then schedule a follow-up meeting on the 7th or 8th with Russ and his PM to demo and explore a POC/trial.
